_comment: Real archive titles used to test the reader-recommendation series/volume parser. The parser's ONLY input is `title` (plus library tags for the weak-association rank) — `series_group`/`volume` are the human-annotated expected answers used solely by the test to grade the parser, never fed to it (no cheating: the runtime code has no notion of `series_group`). Grading is by grouping equivalence, not string match: titles sharing a `series_group` must yield the SAME parser series key, titles in different groups must yield DIFFERENT keys, and `volume` must match exactly. Non-volume numbers (character names like 2B, frame-id noise -f\d+-\d+_n\d+, edition markers [DL版], 後編) must never parse as volumes. Groups A-N are the live library's own titles (2026-08-04); group X are real external examples (Amazon/Wikipedia/小学館 listings) exercising volume-notational variants. Groups E-H are 36 live e-hentai search results for 架空アンソロジー (fetched 2026-08-04, logged-in session): 銀花猫 巻のN uses 大字 numerals (壱弐参拾, 拾参=13), series+volume live inside the (... ) suffix on single-story titles, one title has a mismatched full-width opening paren (いろりそう（…)), one has doubled spaces before the paren, one has no space before the paren; 銀花猫様 uses Vol.N. 1TESTA's 1 and テストヤと3つのお願い's 3 are title content, not volumes.
